title: Amtrak deploys thirteen modified boarding ramps, bringing the completed-car total to 141
summary: Amtrak reports thirteen modified ramp installations on Superliner sleeper cars during the six-month period, bringing the cumulative completed-car total to 141; it also reports eight bridge-plate holders installed. Denominator: Thirteen ramp-equipped Superliner I and II sleeper cars completed between November 1, 2025 and April 30, 2026, with a separate cumulative total of 141 completed cars.
